Title: Power BI Embedded dashboards with Azure Stream Analytics

Body.Content:
Using Power BI with Azure Stream Analytics enables users of Power BI Embedded dashboards to visualize insights from streaming data within the context of the apps they use every day. With Power BI Embedded, users can also embed real-time dashboards right in their organization's web apps.

No changes are required for your existing Stream Analytics jobs to work with Power BI Embedded. For detailed directions on how you can build and embed dynamic streaming dashboards with Azure Stream Analytics and Power BI, see our tutorial. For more information about the capability, see the blog post.
